title: Market selection and product advertisement
competency: Select a target market and advertise a product.

keywords.def: The part of a market whose customers share features such as age, location, income and lifestyle.
Paid communication that encourages people to buy a product; it informs, persuades and reminds.

en.text: A target market is the part of the market whose customers share features such as location, buying power, age, income and lifestyle. Knowing it helps you reach customers. Advertising is paid communication that encourages people to buy. It uses TV, radio, print, websites, social media and billboards, and has three aims: to inform, to persuade and to remind.

screens.title: Who buys?
screens.ask: You sell school uniforms. Who is your target market?
opts: Parents and students near local schools
screens.after: A target market shares features like age, location and needs.

screens.title: Target market
paras: A target market is one part of the total market for a good or service.
Its consumers share characteristics: buying geography, buying power, demographics and incomes.
Target markets are grouped by age, location, income and lifestyle.

screens.title: Advertising
paras: Product advertising is paid promotional communication that tries to make consumers buy.
Channels: television, radio, print media, websites, social media, billboards.
Three aims: to inform, to persuade and to remind. Informative advertising creates awareness.
Selling skills grow through experience, coaching and training.
